 WTA Hong Kong Round of 16 Best Bets Including Claire Liu vs Katie Boulter 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The 2026 WTA Hong Kong tournament is underway. This is a WTA 250 event. You will not see any of the top players on tour in this event. They are all preparing for the WTA Finals next week in Indian Wells, California. This is a final week for many WTA pros to earn points and maybe learn something about what they are doing so they can carry it into the offseason with their coaches. The tennis season is a very long grind, so this tournament will test how mentally tough these players are. Who will dig deep to win, and who will fade as soon as a match gets difficult? Will we see players who lose first sets battle back, or will there be a lot of straight-set matches this week as struggling players get ready to go home for the offseason and then start over in January? WTA Hong Kong will be interesting for that very reason. LWOS has our best bets for three matches. Post your best bets and thoughts in the comments. 
 WTA Hong Kong 
 Gibson – Sasnovich: 2:30 EST 
 H2H: 0-2 
 In this WTA Hong Kong match, we have a situation where one player, Aliaksandra Sasnovich, has beaten the other player, Talia Gibson, twice this year, both by large margins (seven games or more in each instance). Sasnovich is also 8-2 in her last 10 matches while Gibson is only 5-5. The data points are clearly in Sasnovich’s favor. Can Gibson make adjustments and turn this head-to-head battle in a different direction? 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Hong Kong match has to be viewed as a Sasnovich match. Gibson must prove she can do better. Until then, Sasnovich is the choice. We’re tapping the sign on this match. One player is playing much better than the other, and Sasnovich has also beaten Gibson twice this year already. 
 That being said, betting on Sasnovich -1.5 games is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Sasnovich -1.5 games at 1.61 @1xBet 
 Liu – Boulter: 2:30 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 This WTA Hong Kong match has Katie Boulter as a clear favorite over Claire Liu. Boulter is 4-1 in her last five matches while Liu is 3-2. Boulter is in better current form, but not by a huge margin. 
 Aug 28, 2023; Flushing, NY, USA; Maria Sakkari of Greece in action against Rebeka Masarova of Spain on day one of the 2023 US Open tennis tournament at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center. Mandatory Credit: Jerry Lai-USA TODAY Sports | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Jim Smith 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Hong Kong betting angle is to predict a three-set match. Boulter is in good form but has not been dramatically better than Liu over the course of the full 2026 tennis season. A close match that goes into a third set is a very realistic scenario. Go with over 2.5 sets.  
 That being said, betting on over 2.5 sets is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: over 2.5 sets at 2.42 @betsson 
 Joint – Sakkari: 4:00 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 This WTA Hong Kong match features red-hot Maya Joint, who is 7-2 in her last nine matches, against betting market favorite Maria Sakkari, who is 5-4 in her last nine matches. Both players have been better in the past several weeks compared to what they achieved earlier in the year. Should Sakkari be a strong betting favorite given how well Joint is playing? 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Hong Kong match feels like a match in which Joint might not win outright, but will probably win one set. She is playing really well, and Sakkari’s current form isn’t quite as good. Joint on the set spread is a reasonable play here. 
 That being said, betting on Joint +1.5 sets is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Joint +1.5 sets @1.65 @Interwetten
